title: Facilitated Exclusion Process in Higher Dimensions: Recurrent Structure and Transient Dynamics
summary: In this article, we study the facilitated exclusion process (FEP) on the $d$-dimensional discrete torus of side length $N$, with $d\ge2$. For Bernoulli initial data with a fixed density $ρ\in(0,1)$, we first prove that, with high probability, the particle-number sector selected by the initial configuration has a unique active recurrent class if $ρ>1-2^{-d}$ and multiple recurrent classes if $ρ<1-2^{-d}$.
